title: Set Up Static Files for Production
description: Configure STATIC_ROOT, run collectstatic, and test with Whitenoise.
problemStatement:
## Your Mission

Prepare your app for production static file serving:
1. Set `STATIC_ROOT = BASE_DIR / 'staticfiles'`.
2. Install `whitenoise` and add it to `MIDDLEWARE`.
3. Run `python manage.py collectstatic`.
4. Run your app with `gunicorn` (or test locally with `runserver` after disabling DEBUG) to ensure static files are served.
hints: Ensure `DEBUG` is False to test production behavior.
expectedOutput: After collecting static files, your static assets (CSS, JS) are served correctly even when `DEBUG=False`.
solutionCode:
# settings.py
STATIC_ROOT = BASE_DIR / 'staticfiles'

MIDDLEWARE = [
    'django.middleware.security.SecurityMiddleware',
    'whitenoise.middleware.WhiteNoiseMiddleware',
    ...
]

# Terminal
python manage.py collectstatic
# Then run gunicorn or set DEBUG=False and use runserver to test
